# HL Privateer — v2: sentiment-driven outcome market trading on Hyperliquid HIP-4
# https://hlprivateer.xyz

## What this is

An experimental, self-hosted trading agent for HIP-4 outcome contracts on
Hyperliquid. Sentiment in, probability estimate out, fail-closed risk gates,
order placement on ALLOW.

Outcome contracts are binary: settle 0 or 1 in USDH on the same CLOB as
spot/perp. Price ∈ [0,1] is implied probability.

The previous experiment (v1, perp discretionary trading desk with a 7-role
crew) is concluded and preserved under /legacy. On-site retrospective at
https://hlprivateer.xyz/v1.

## No fallbacks

There are no built-in simulators, fake data sources, or "kicks in if real
isn't configured" paths. Production paths require real Hyperliquid access:

- ORACLE_HL_USER must be set (HyperliquidAccountant reads clearinghouseState).
- apps/oracle/wiring.ts must exist (operator implements OutcomeMarketProvider
  + OrderRouter against HL HIP-4 — gitignored, copy from wiring.template.ts).
- SENTINEL_LLM_COMMAND must be set (shell that pipes prompt to stdin, reads
  model response from stdout — e.g. `claude -p`).

If any required piece is missing, the binary refuses to start. Tests inline
their own fakes locally.

## Architecture

- apps/sentinel — pluggable source adapters + LlmScorer (shell-out completer);
  emits SentimentSignal envelopes onto the hlpv2.sentiment Redis stream.
- apps/oracle — orchestrator + HTTP API. Runs three roles:
  - SNT: aggregate sentiment → ProbabilityEstimate (pHat, edge, confidence)
  - EXE: build OutcomeProposal (side, limit, Kelly-sized stake)
  - RSK: 14 fail-closed gates → RiskDecision
- packages/outcome-engine — pure math: aggregateSentiment, estimateProbability,
  computeEdge, kellyFraction, proposeOrder.
- packages/outcome-risk — pure gates: evaluate(RiskContext) → RiskDecision.
- packages/contracts — Zod schemas for OutcomeMarket, SentimentSignal,
  ProbabilityEstimate, OutcomeProposal, RiskDecision, OutcomeFill, RiskConfig,
  StrategyConfig.
- packages/strategy — gitignored JSON loader (risk + prompts + sources +
  estimation + market filter).
- packages/event-bus — Redis Streams abstraction (in-memory test impl).
- packages/hl-client — Hyperliquid HTTP transport + typed info wrappers
  (clearinghouseState, userFills, userFillsByTime, accountValueUsd).

## Hyperliquid is the source of truth

Positions, equity, and fills live on HL. We don't maintain parallel state.
HyperliquidAccountant reads clearinghouseState (TTL-cached) and exposes:

- positions(), equityUsd(), openExposureUsd(), openMarketCount(),
  clusterExposureUsd(market), warmup(), recentFills().

HL errors propagate; no graceful-degradation fallback.

## Public endpoints

- GET /healthz       — mode + metrics + equityUsd + openMarkets
- GET /metrics       — Prometheus 0.0.4 (mode gauge + equity gauge + 6 counters)
- GET /v1/public/markets      — markets with pHat + edge (no sizes)
- GET /v1/public/floor        — mode + markets + recent role tape
- GET /v1/public/floor-tape   — recent role tape only

Operator (Bearer token):
- POST /v1/operator/halt
- POST /v1/operator/resume

Both return 401 when ORACLE_OPERATOR_TOKEN is unset (fail-closed).

## Risk gates (14, evaluated cheapest-first)

1. OPERATOR_HALT
2. INVALID_PROPOSAL
3. PROPOSAL_EXPIRED
4. STALE_SENTIMENT
5. MARKET_NOT_TRADING
6. RESOLUTION_TOO_SOON
7. RESOLUTION_TOO_FAR
8. CHALLENGE_WINDOW_OPEN
9. EDGE_TOO_THIN
10. STAKE_PER_MARKET
11. CONCURRENT_MARKETS
12. CORRELATED_EXPOSURE
13. BANKROLL_DEPLETED
14. LOW_LIQUIDITY

Any failure → DENY (fail-closed, single-failure short-circuit).

## Key invariants (ported from v1)

- AI proposes, never executes. The risk engine is the only ALLOW path.
- Pure-function gates. Zero I/O. Deterministic.
- Hash-chained audit (SHA-256 prev-hash chain on hlpv2.audit).
- Privacy by default — public surface omits positions and notional.
- Per-market evaluation mutex prevents over-fill under concurrent signals.
- Hyperliquid is the source of truth — no parallel ledger.
